subject.title: Home dashboard: agent-docked widgets and a Pages shelf

question: Should OpenClaw core sponsor a v1 Home dashboard now, and if so, which dock placement, refresh model, persistence scope, and platform-parity boundary are the supported contract?
rationale: The proposal creates a durable core product and protocol surface rather than repairing an established broken behavior; the remaining choices determine storage, gateway, security, and UI ownership.

options.title: Define a narrow v1 after Home lands
options.body: Choose one desktop Home dock placement, static agent-updated widget payloads, per-agent local pages, vertical ordering only, and explicitly defer mobile/native and sharing.

options.title: Defer dashboard surfaces
options.body: Keep Home as the main-session entry point until a broader dashboard product direction and platform plan are ready.

options.title: Seek an extension seam first
options.body: Explore whether the existing widget and plugin contracts can support optional dashboard content without adding core page CRUD.

recommendation.title: Define a narrow v1 after Home lands
recommendation.body: Choose one desktop Home dock placement, static agent-updated widget payloads, per-agent local pages, vertical ordering only, and explicitly defer mobile/native and sharing.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue and related open UI work describe owner-directed design iterations and establish the immediate product context.
